Lost in the Desert

Aliya was imprisoned with her trusted partner Sahilya, who managed to escape. Since she never reached the Last Refuge, she must still be in the desert. Aliya asks you to find out what happened to her best friend.

Objectives

Find Sahilya

Explore the northern desert

Explore the northeastern desert

Escort Sahilya to the Last Refuge

Sahilya must survive
